info.name: HRMS — Org Chart
info.description:
Company organisation tree for the Company Profile page.

Hierarchy: company -> admin(s) -> branch -> department -> head of department -> employees.

Node types: `company`, `admin`, `branch`, `department`, `department_head`, `employee`.

Notes:
- The head of a department is NOT repeated inside that department's `children`.
- `branch.unassigned_employees` = employees of that branch with no department.
- `tree.unassigned_employees` = employees with no branch at all.
- `tree.branches` is the canonical list; each admin in `tree.children` carries the same branch nodes so the UI can draw one single-rooted tree.
- `department.needs_head` is true only when the department has employees but no head.

request.description: Full company tree. Any authenticated role can read it. Use `summary.departments_missing_head` to flag departments that have employees but no head.

response.name: 200 OK
